correctness.rationale: Proof over Z, not just field computations: for every connected G the spanning-tree inclusion BI_3(T)⊂BI_3(G) gives π1=0 and an explicit relative 3-chain telescoping for every added 2-face gives H2=0. For n≥5 no triangle/5-cycle ensures dimension 3, exact face counts (2n,C(2n,2),6n(n−2),C(3n,2)−7n), and free H3 of rank 1+C(n+1,2). Alexander duality shifts the group to degree 2n−6; an independent-set/degree bound shows the dual has complete 2-skeleton; Hurewicz–Whitehead yields an integral sphere wedge. Exact full simplicial GF2 ranks for all n=5..14, relative telescopes and full dual GF2 ranks for n=5,6 replay via attached verify.py. No finite tests used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: This resolves the total-three-cut portion of the explicit Möbius-ladder homotopy direction in Agarwal–Basak 2026 §6 Problem 26 for every n>=5, with an exact integral homotopy classification and quadratic sphere multiplicity. It is an infinite, natural graph-family theorem rather than a routine new finite case. The argument identifies why 2-connectivity of the bounded-independence dual and its simple four-cycle count control all higher homotopy information. The n=4 exception and the absence of equivariant claims clarify scope and motivation.
